verdicts.reason: A: the oversized Meridian logo runs into the blue panel's left edge (the final 'n' touches or is clipped by it). The CTA and 40% badge are shrunk to tiny chips, and the glasses illustration sits jammed beside them in the panel. There is an awkward dead gap between headline and subcopy, and the panel's bottom area is empty. B has the same flaws: an oversized logo next to a tiny CTA and badge, with the glasses moved into the panel. Its panel is also jammed against the top and right canvas edges and the logo nearly touches the left edge. But the logo clears the panel and the headline-to-subcopy spacing is tighter, so B is marginally less broken.
